ul.li: The lock is associated with the shared object, not with individual methods.
If one thread is executing a synchronized instance method, other threads cannot execute any other synchronized instance method on the same object simultaneously.
Other threads can execute non-synchronized instance methods on the same object.
Other threads can also execute non-synchronized static methods.
